name: kasir-restoran
description: Backend and Frontend for Restaurant Cashier Dashboard

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:dump: docker exec kasir-db sh -c "exec mysqldump -uroot -p\"$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD\" --routines --no-tablespaces --databases kasir_restoran" > database/kasir_restoran.sql
